target_quality_rule: 25th percentile of unlabeled eligible AD2 Q values

adapter.has_candidate: num_candidates > 0, or finite M if unavailable

frozen_decision_rule.strong_retain: mean delta >= 0, wins >= 3/4, worst category delta >= -0.005
frozen_decision_rule.noninferior_only: mean delta >= -0.005 and worst category delta >= -0.010
